Detailed Description

Templated concrete Column subclass representing columns with scalar row entries.

ColumnData<T> has a data member of type std::vector<T> of size HDU::rows() holding the data entries. It implements all scalar columns, as used in FITS Ascii Tables, and also implements Binary Table columns with string arrays as row entries.
